Hierve el Agua lies in the mountains around Oaxaca. Mineral deposits on the slopes resemble frozen waterfalls. Natural pools sit above the valley, offering mountain views.

Visitors come to see these natural formations and walk beside the rocky terraces. On a journey through Oaxaca, Hierve el Agua is combined with Mitla, weaving workshops, and an introduction to mezcal production.

The Holandes Cays are part of Panama's San Blas island region. Small islands are surrounded by Caribbean waters and a barrier reef. White shores, greenery, and shades of turquoise in the shallows define the seascape.

Stops in the archipelago are dedicated to swimming, fishing, and exploring the underwater world. Yacht itineraries offer views of the islands from the water, while walks along the shore allow visitors to see individual areas up close. The Holandes Cays add a more remote island section to a journey through San Blas, with the sea and reefs at the heart of the experience.

updatedAt: '2026-10-15'

The monument is associated with the ceremonial and burial traditions of the region's ancient cultures. The complex is particularly striking for its warm earthen color, stepped forms, and broad sloping surfaces.

Huallamarca should not be confused with Huaca Pucllana: they are separate archaeological sites in Lima, located in San Isidro and Miraflores, respectively. A specific tour itinerary may include only a view from outside while passing by, so access to the site itself should be checked against the program.

The site is associated with the Moche culture and discoveries of rulers' burials, known from accounts of the Lord of Sipán. Adobe mounds and excavation areas reveal the character of the region's ancient structures.

A visit connects the archaeological landscape with the history of the discoveries and the organization of ancient society. Huaca Rajada adds depth to an exploration of northern Peru, where the itinerary brings together cities, museums, and monuments of pre-Columbian cultures. A local guide helps explain why this place holds an important position in the region's history.
